sentences.en: Female hormone imbalance is a major cause of infertility.
sentences.zh: 女性荷尔蒙失衡是不孕的主要原因。

sentences.en: Love is nothing more than a temporary hormone imbalance.
sentences.zh: 爱情无非就是一种暂时性的荷尔蒙失调。

sentences.en: Hormone replacement therapy can contribute to breast cancer risk.
sentences.zh: 激素替代疗法可能增加患乳腺癌的风险。

senses.zh: 激素的 形容词: hormonal
